Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Big Apple ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Jackson & Perkins (United States, 2003).
Introduced in Italy by Rose Barni in 2003 as 'Big Apple'.
rows.Bloom: Rose-pink, carmine-red edges. Strong fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals), exhibition, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
